integrity: Integer coefficient arrays are recomputed by syndrome-state and independent Fourier-character recurrences. No outside or independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result only treats the six naturally cyclic binary length-31 Hamming realizations and read lengths 2, 3, 4; it does not prove a general all-length identity, compare arbitrary coordinate permutations, or establish independent historical priority.
title: Three distinct cyclic symbol-read spectra among the six binary length-31 Hamming codes
